description: Toyotomi Hideyoshi , otherwise known as Kinoshita Tōkichirō  and Hashiba Hideyoshi , was a Japanese samurai and daimyō of the late Sengoku and Azuchi-Momoyama periods and regarded as the second "Great Unifier" of Japan. Although he came from a peasant background, he rose to become the most powerful man in Japan, earning the rank and title of Kampaku  and Daijō-daijin , the highest official position and title in the nobility class.
